tagline.zh: Motion 变体编排:容器把 staggerChildren 下发给子项,每个列表项错峰入场——第 i 项在 i × stagger 后启动,总铺开时间 = stagger × (n−1)。
tagline.en: Motion variant orchestration: the container hands staggerChildren down to its children, and list items enter in sequence — item i starts at i × stagger, with total spread = stagger × (n−1).

origin.zh: Motion transitions 文档的编排能力:delay(负值=中途开始)、repeat、repeatType,文档页目录明确含「delay and stagger」编排(stagger 细节未被调研截取,调研 04§1.3);demo 用变体的 staggerChildren 实现,单位为秒。
origin.en: The orchestration capability of Motion's transitions docs: delay (negative = start mid-flight), repeat, repeatType, with the docs page's TOC explicitly listing "delay and stagger" orchestration (stagger details were not captured by the research, research 04 §1.3); the demo implements it via variant staggerChildren, which is in seconds.

effect.zh: 相邻子项的启动间隔,demo 换算成秒传给 Motion 变体的 staggerChildren。调研只记载 Motion 文档页含「delay and stagger」编排能力,staggerChildren 默认值未被截取——40ms 为社区常见值,未证实。
effect.en: The start interval between adjacent children; the demo converts it to seconds for Motion's staggerChildren. The research only records that the Motion docs page covers "delay and stagger" orchestration, without the staggerChildren default — 40ms is a common community value, unverified.

effect.zh: 子项数量(演示用枚举)。总铺开时间 = stagger × (n−1) 随项数线性增长——项数越多,同样 stagger 下末项等待越久。
effect.en: Number of children (a demo enum). Total spread = stagger × (n−1) grows linearly with item count — more items mean a longer wait for the last one at the same stagger.

note.zh: 客户端 JS 动效库,不依赖新 CSS 特性;需 JS 可执行,禁用 JS 时列表直接以最终状态渲染。本次调研未逐浏览器核验其支持矩阵。
note.en: A client-side JS animation library with no reliance on new CSS features; requires JS, and the list renders in its final state without it. Its per-browser matrix was not audited in this research pass.

fallback.zh: prefers-reduced-motion 时去掉位移、改用纯 opacity 交错淡入(淡入淡出降级)——大平移是前庭障碍的常见触发源(MDN prefers-reduced-motion,调研 04§6.1),节奏保留、位移取消。
fallback.en: Under prefers-reduced-motion, drop the displacement and cross-fade with opacity only (a fade fallback) — large translations are a common vestibular trigger (MDN prefers-reduced-motion, research 04 §6.1); the rhythm stays, the movement goes.

use.zh: 列表/卡片组的首次入场(导航项、功能区、结果列表)
use.en: First entrance of lists/card groups (nav items, feature blocks, result lists)

use.zh: 向导/表单的分步揭示,引导视线按序推进
use.en: Step-by-step reveals in wizards/forms that walk the eye in order

use.zh: 叙事型页面的节奏性入场,配合 M3 进入类时长档位(decelerate 250–400ms,调研 04§1.4)
use.en: Rhythmic entrances on narrative pages, paired with M3's enter-class duration tiers (decelerate 250–400ms, research 04 §1.4)

avoid.zh: 长列表(>20 项)整段 stagger——末项等待线性拉长,用户会错过尾部内容
avoid.en: Staggering the whole of long lists (>20 items) — the last item's wait grows linearly and users miss the tail

avoid.zh: 用户主动触发的重复操作(每次点击都点名入场)
avoid.en: User-initiated repeated actions (a roll-call entrance on every click)

avoid.zh: 需要立刻可用的关键路径——编排感不能以可读性为代价(HIG:动效可取消、简短精确)
avoid.en: Critical paths that must be instantly usable — orchestration must not cost readability (HIG: motion is cancellable and brief)

a11y.zh: 位移类入场是前庭触发源,必须响应 prefers-reduced-motion(降级为 opacity 淡入);列表保持 ul/li 语义,动画不改变可达性结构;末项落定前的内容不应承载关键信息,或提供「跳过」路径(HIG:动效可取消)。
a11y.en: Displacement entrances are vestibular triggers and must honor prefers-reduced-motion (fade to opacity); the list keeps ul/li semantics and animation never changes the accessibility tree; content before the last item settles should not carry key information, or offer a skip path (HIG: motion is cancellable).

goal.zh: 复刻一个列表的错峰入场:N 个列表项从下方 16px 处淡入上浮,相邻项延迟按快照 stagger 错开,容器变体用 staggerChildren 编排;显示总铺开时间 stagger × (n−1)。
goal.en: Replicate a staggered list entrance: N list items fade in and rise 16px, adjacent items offset by the snapshot stagger, orchestrated by a container variant with staggerChildren; display the total spread stagger × (n−1).

acceptance.zh: 容器变体 transition.staggerChildren = 快照 stagger(换算成秒),子项共享 itemVariants
acceptance.en: The container variant sets transition.staggerChildren = snapshot stagger (converted to seconds); children share itemVariants

acceptance.zh: 第 i 项延迟 ≈ i × stagger,第一项 0 延迟立即入场
acceptance.en: Item i starts at ≈ i × stagger; the first item has zero delay

acceptance.zh: 只动画 opacity 与 translate(合成器属性)
acceptance.en: Animate only opacity and translate (compositor properties)

acceptance.zh: prefers-reduced-motion: reduce 时去掉位移,改纯 opacity 交错淡入
acceptance.en: Under prefers-reduced-motion: reduce, drop displacement and cross-fade with opacity only

acceptance.zh: 列表为语义 ul/li,参数或重播变化时整段编排从头重放
acceptance.en: The list is semantic ul/li; parameter or replay changes restart the whole orchestration
